doc.launch: The bundled source-built binary receives -config window:fullscreen=yes followed by one positional ROM; a playlist launch adds the transient -config pair from playlist.args before disc 1. There is no host, Flatpak, or libretro launch route.
doc.state: Flycast reads ${state_root}/config/flycast/emu.cfg and its generated SDL keyboard mapping through XDG_CONFIG_HOME. VMUs, native saves, save states, shader cache, logs, and writable flash remain below the isolated XDG data/cache roots.
doc.firmware: Named Dreamcast boot/flash files are copied once into isolated state from read-only external roots. The shared Emulation, ROM, and project BIOS trees are never writable.
doc.input: SDL GameController supplies gameplay. The generated version-4 SDL keyboard mapping consumes the shared Ctrl+Q/Ctrl+A/Ctrl+S/Ctrl+M actions for quit/load/save/menu; the target process watcher owns immediate physical Select+Start quit.
doc.rendering: RendererType 0 pins OpenGL. libsemupreload (render_preload) composes Semu's bezel and shader at the SDL/EGL swap: it reads the emulator's back buffer and writes the composed frame back before the real swap.
doc.playlist: Flycast 2.7 opens no .m3u: OpenDisc knows only the chd, gdi, cdi and cue drivers, and a command-line start exits cleanly on "Unknown disk format". Semu therefore passes the playlist's first disc (playlist.open first_entry) and, for this run only (a -config value is transient and never saved to emu.cfg), points Dreamcast.ContentPath at the playlist's folder, so Commands > Eject Disk then Insert Disk lists that game's own discs. Flycast's -config parser (core/cfg/cl.cpp:36-168) ends a quoted value at the next matching quote, and the ContentPath list splits on semicolons (core/cfg/option.h:210-262), so playlist.quote wraps the folder in double quotes, or in single quotes when it holds a double quote; commas, colons, equals signs and spaces survive either. A folder holding both quotes or a semicolon cannot be expressed: Semu then leaves the pair out and says so, and disc 1 boots as before.
doc.content: What Flycast 5aa091fd opens: the chd, gdi, cdi and cue disc drivers (core/imgread/common.cpp:19-26), .elf through the HLE BIOS (core/emulator.cpp:609), and .zip/.7z/.bin/.dat/.lst as NAOMI or Atomiswave carts (core/emulator.cpp:554-557). No .m3u: Semu opens playlists for it (playlist.open first_entry).

save_states.doc: Flycast cycles ten slots and wraps both ways, showing slot + 1 (core/ui/gui.cpp:518-522, 1620-1624 at 5aa091f); emu.cfg starts each launch on slot 0.

menu.doc: Flycast declares no pause action (its btn_pause opens its own pause screen), so the Semu menu draws over the running game.
